subject.title: fix(file-transfer): honor OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR for audit log path

question: Should file-transfer audit records remain a JSONL product artifact that moves with `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, or should this behavior be implemented only through the current canonical SQLite audit-state model?
rationale: The branch changes persistent audit storage, while the existing review record says the JSONL path is retired; selecting the permanent audit-storage contract requires maintainer intent rather than a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Use the canonical audit store
options.body: Confirm the current SQLite owner and rework or replace this branch so state-directory isolation is implemented without reviving JSONL persistence.

options.title: Retain JSONL as an explicit artifact
options.body: Document JSONL as the supported audit artifact, add an upgrade/migration plan for existing isolated deployments, and require real gateway proof.

recommendation.title: Use the canonical audit store
recommendation.body: Confirm the current SQLite owner and rework or replace this branch so state-directory isolation is implemented without reviving JSONL persistence.
